# Store Content / Age Rating — Questionnaire Draft

**Status:** Draft answers for Apple age rating and Google content rating questionnaires.
**Final rating values** are generated by each portal after answers are submitted (**portal-blocked**).

**Product posture:** Adult-oriented personal coaching / commitment accountability. Not a game. Not social networking for strangers. Not pornography. Not medical treatment.
